notes.title: Waiting on Steam for Release
notes.notes:
[p]Unfortunately, Skaldsong is still sitting in the review queue for release thru Steam. I've had a release build ready for over a month now, but it's been kicked back multiple times (Their reviews have taken 1-2 weeks each time instead of the 3-5 days they usually quote). So unfortunately, I can't release the game until they mark it as ready. 

Sorry for anyone who's been waiting for today, but I have no ability to change it. Only Steam does.[/p]

notes.title: An Update on the Release Date
notes.notes: [p]Hello again![/p][p][/p][p]Regarding the last update, the main issue Steam had with the release has been fixed and implemented. However, over the past few weeks of working on Skaldsong, it's become clear that since the original planned release date, there have been a LOT of improvements to systems and QoL. And due to this, I want to make sure I spend the extra time polishing the game and reworking some parts that need the extra attention. [/p][p][/p][p]So with that in mind, I'm looking towards releasing some time in September instead. I am currently targeting September 12th to be the official release date. Beta keys are still available on the discord for anyone wanting to try and play the game [i]now[/i], but if you're waiting for full release, that's the hold up. [/p][p][/p][p]Sorry for the extra wait for anyone waiting till full release, but I want the game to be the best it can be before it's out to the public![/p]

notes.title: Release Date Delayed
notes.notes:
[p]Unfortunately, the release date of the 3rd of July isn't going to happen, Steam is required that I change the AI model use to a steam-supported payment method, thus, middlemanning the service between the player and the AI. I originally had this design before scrapping it, but I am going to do the best I can to get it in the hands of everyone as soon as possible.

If you want to get your hands on a copy faster than steam will let me, join the discord server as I will be putting out pre-release test versions.

[url="https://discord.gg/BX4cZWTF2Q"]https://discord.gg/BX4cZWTF2Q[/url][/p]
